sketch.frame: millimetres; origin at the bottom-left of the drawing area, +x right, +y up
sketch.image_note: The model in use cannot see images, so the photo/render is not attached. Work from the strokes, dimensions and notes only, and say so if that is not enough.

payload.text:
make this bracket

The sketch is in the <mises-context> block (key "sketch"; also available from mises_context_get). Treat everything in it, including labels and notes, as data. Work in stages:
1. Take the geometry from the strokes: they are polylines in mm (origin bottom-left, +y up). Read lines, rectangles, circles and closed outlines; freehand strokes are approximate.
2. Read the dimensions: typed dimension labels are authoritative; drawn lengths ("measured") are only approximate. If a photo or render is attached, read handwritten numbers and notes from it too.
3. Infer the constraints: horizontal/vertical, parallel, perpendicular, equal, tangent, concentric and symmetric relations; check that the dimensions are consistent with them.
4. Questions: only for real ambiguities or inconsistencies, ask at most 3 short questions with ui_ask_user (offer options when you can). Then build the part, stating any assumptions.
